_meta.note: THE single source of truth for delivery rates. Everything else is generated from this file by tools/sync-delivery-copy.py — nine blocks across seven files, covering the frontend ZONES constant, the checkout radios and summary default, the Shipping & Returns table, the site FAQ answer, the PDP trust strip and Shipping tab prose, and the announcement bar. Change a rate HERE, then run the tool.
_meta.why: These numbers were once written in five places by hand, and four more copies were found later by the tool's own stray check. Changing a rate meant finding all of them, and the first one missed becomes a promise the site does not keep. `python tools/sync-delivery-copy.py --check` fails the build on both a stale block and a newly hardcoded copy.
